main_text.l: mum his omnibus subjungit, ut Barberi-
no in omnibus satisfaciat, optâsse qui-
dem Capellum, novam fieri veteris testa-
in cujus margine variæ lectiones undiq;
selectæ collocarentur, sed hoc non præ-
tionibus præferri, at novam ex Hebraeo
in omnibus se ostendit Criticæ Sacræ
dignaque est profecto hæc Epistola, quæ
in lucem edatur, ut Theologi præsertim
editionem adorant, eosque ferre non pos-
sunt, qui de nova ad contextum Hebræum aut Græcum translatione paranda

page.notes: Printed text runs as the printer set it; the word "Ludovici" and "Capelli" are as printed. Several words are slightly blurred in the scan, notably "optâsse" (printed "optâsse" with circumflex, read as "optâsse"; may be "optasse"), "variæ", "pleriqve" and "Concilii". "Criticæ Sacræ" is printed with a space and a cramped ligature; "Sacræ" may read "Sacræ". The first word "ligi" begins a fragment of a word from the previous page ("obligi" or "ligi") and is kept as a fragment. Some words run together in the printing (e.g. "debeatConcilii", "Hebræo"); printed spacing errors are left as they are. The word "optâsse" is uncertain and marked below.
